features._comment: Toggle optional features without editing code.

qr._comment: QR codes shown on the page, the PDF card, and print. mapUrl points at the Park City Resort pin in Malout using coordinates only - the place_id previously carried here was dead (no title/description/coords returned) and could resolve anywhere. GPS needs Latin/ASCII, so never the Punjabi address. The contact QR is a vCard for Nirman (his phone) with the venue address.
